criteria_outcomes.criterion: mark exact capability matches as direct coverage
leave missing capability matches unsupported without inventing capability ids

reviews.decision_reason: The coverage output matches exact need-to-capability handoffs: six exact capability matches are marked direct with their capability_id, and the two needs without capabilities remain unsupported with empty capability_id. Record identifiers are preserved.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
derive unsupported flag consistently from coverage status
use upstream provenance rank as ordering within each support group
support deterministic recommendation from correct top priority

reviews.decision_reason: This is the behaviorally significant root cause. The boundary is supposed to rank unsupported needs before covered needs, but the priorities output places covered direct items first and marks them unsupported=true, while the actually unsupported coverage rows are last and marked unsupported=false. That inversion changes the top ranked need and drives the final recommendation to the wrong covered item.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: The boundary retains the full eight-item priority window and constructs the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record. The recommendation is wrong only because the input priority ordering was already inverted upstream of this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve demanded corpus rows into selected records
establish real customer demand beyond supplied synthetic demand fields

reviews.decision_reason: The downstream handoff contains the eight demanded corpus records with their record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight preserved. No supplied evidence shows an erroneous selection or fallback-path defect.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: normalize only the bounded allowed-record window
preserve record ids, needs, scores, source ids, and source weights
validate jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes

reviews.decision_reason: The handed-off needs remain within the allowed eight-record window and preserve the relevant demand fields. The package does not expose contradictory normalization evidence.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: build ranked evidence-source provenance for all normalized needs
treat repeated history as independent corroboration

reviews.decision_reason: The evidence_sources handoff preserves ranked provenance for all eight normalized needs in source order, with source_id and source_weight present. No supplied evidence shows a provenance assembly fault.
